en-US.author: Mohamad Yahia
en-US.description: Native agent CLIs manager with Ghostty terminals, an embedded browser, and an IDE.
en-US.longDescription:
Ghostex is an all-in-one native agents workspace: agent chats, a code editor, and a browser for every agent CLI and subscription you have, in one fast native window built with Rust and GPUI.

Features:
- A real chat for every agent — thinking, tool calls, and file edits fold into tidy cards, diffs are readable, images are clickable, and prompts queue while the agent works. It is still the agent's own CLI underneath, and the raw terminal is one hotkey away.
- Coordinators that run the work — tell a coordinator what needs doing and it hands each piece to a thread it starts, briefs, and keeps track of, in its own Git worktree when threads should run in parallel.
- Multiple Claude and Codex accounts with automatic failover when limits are hit.
- Remote access to your machines via phone pairing or Tailscale.
- Optional plugins for Linear, Jira, GitHub, Sentry, and more.

Linux x64: .deb · .rpm · tarball (mise/ubi) · AppImage · AUR (ghostex-bin) · Linux ARM64: .deb · .rpm · tarball · AppImage
Android: APK · iOS: TestFlight through Discord (post in the iOS channel)
10.42.1 - 2026-11-01
Ghostex 10.42.1 is out. Larger pasted images work in chat, and answers from forms and pages reach a busy agent sooner.
💬 Chat
- Paste images up to 32 MiB on the computer and web. BMP and TIFF images are sent as PNG, very large pictures are reduced when needed, and the chat box shows the image size and limit if one still cannot fit. OpenCode reduces large images further when sending them.
- Answers from question forms and chat pages send like normal messages, reaching a busy agent after its current tool call when supported, on the computer and phone. Turn on the Advanced setting Wait for turn end before sending form answers to keep the previous wait.
Windows beta packages are not Authenticode-signed and may show a SmartScreen warning.

zh-CN.description: 原生智能体 CLI 管理器，内置 Ghostty 终端、浏览器与 IDE。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Ghostex 是一体化原生智能体工作区：为你拥有的每个智能体 CLI 和订阅提供智能体聊天、代码编辑器和浏览器，全部汇聚在一个由 Rust 和 GPUI 构建的快速原生窗口中。

特性：
- 每个智能体都有真正的聊天界面 — 思考过程、工具调用和文件编辑折叠成整洁的卡片，diff 清晰可读，图片可以点击，智能体工作时提示词会排队。底层仍是智能体自己的 CLI，一键热键即可切换到原始终端。
- 会干活的协调者 — 告诉协调者要做什么，它会把每项工作交给它自己启动、布置并跟踪的线程，需要并行时各线程还能拥有独立的 Git worktree。
- 支持多个 Claude 和 Codex 账号，达到用量限额时自动切换。
- 通过手机配对或 Tailscale 远程访问你的机器。
- 可选插件支持 Linear、Jira、GitHub、Sentry 等。
